pr_title: planner,executor: fix join resolveIndex won't find its column from children schema & amend join's lused and rused logic for reversed column ref from join schema to its children
pr_body:
<!--

PR Title Format:

2. *: what's changed

### What problem does this PR solve?
<!--

Please create an issue first to describe the problem.

There MUST be one line starting with "Issue Number:  " and
linking the relevant issues via the "close" or "ref".

For more info, check https://pingcap.github.io/tidb-dev-guide/contribute-to-tidb/contribute-code.html#referring-to-an-issue.

-->

Issue Number: close https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/42588

Problem Summary:

### What changed and how does it work?
issue https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/42588 is caused by many factors and this pr is try to resolve them all.
* first: resolve parent pointer modification error caused by the apply elimination, as mentioned here https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/42588#issuecomment-1929026146
* second: since TiDB internal has many non-rigorous logical optimizing rules, occasionally two or more of them will leading a critical assumption which will lead a resolveIndex error as mentioned here: https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/pull/45831#discussion_r1481031471
* third: in the execution of join, the inline projection's `lused` and `rused` are order unawareness, which means even if we  allow reversed column ref in join schema itself to its children, it will break its assumption here too. So we need to fix here as well.
example: 
```
join schema[col11, col22, col21], child1 [col1], child2 [col21, col22]
the pull/45831 make an assumption here that join schema won't refer a column-order revered from the order of its children. Like here [col22, col21] in join schema is reversed with  [col21, col22] from its child2. Step2 try to fix this.

in the execution layer.
join schema[col11, col22, col21], child1 [col1], child2 [col21, col22]
the lused will be [true]
the rused will be [true, true]
when constructing the join row result, the order couldn't be restored from a simple bool array. Consequently one join result will be shown like: <col1, col21, col22> while the field type is totally different from what the datum in the same position. So step3 try to fix this.
```

```
**mysql_bk.sql:** [mysql_bk.txt](https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/files/11069677/mysql_bk.txt)

**Testcase**
```
select  
  (select  
      subq_1.c0 as c0
    from 
      t273 as ref_84
    where exists (
        select

                  ref_86.c1147 as c0

我改了3个地方目前可以执行：
1、t2子查询增加一列 dsd
2、调整t4的union all 顺序
3、外层返回t2的dsd列

t273 is a view which quite complicated for debugging, simplifying it as substituting it with t271
```
select  
  (select  
      subq_1.c0 as c0
    from 
      t271 as ref_84
    where exists (
        select  
            (select  
                  ref_86.c1147 as c0
                from 
                  t272 as ref_86
                where (subq_1.c0) > (subq_1.c0)
                window w0 as (partition by ref_86.c1147 order by ref_86.c1143 desc)
                order by c0 limit 1
            ) as c3, 
            (select  
                  subq_1.c0 as c0
                from 
                  t271 as ref_89
                order by c0 limit 1) as c4 
          from 
            t271 as ref_85
          )
    order by c0 desc limit 1) as c1 
from 
  (select 1 as c0) as subq_1;

```

```
apply-semi   <--------+
    + apply-leftout1  |
    |    child0---+---+       <------+  (here when we still use apply.child0.columnPrune, we will go into next sub-interative)
    |    child1   |                  |  
    +...          +-apply-leftout2   |  (here we find another valid case and substitute parent pointer's childs as child0, which)
                      +child0 -------+  (leading apply-leftout2 only has 1 child at most, and the following merge schema action will panic)
                      +child1

two problems here
1: when we modify the parent pointer's children, we better return the control to its parent pointer, and let itself to step into column prune again, continuing operating
a invalid child0 pointer is risky.
2: when set parent operator's current child, what we really want to do is using C to substitute what is in position of that B in A (A->B->C), rather
than change all the children that A has.
```
And another problem related to resolve index https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/pull/45831#discussion_r1481031471
